visual_observations: Deep blue contoured ergonomic bar of soap (~199.5 mm length, ~128.2 mm width, ~95.4 mm height).
Bilateral symmetry across vertical and horizontal center planes with hourglass waist narrowing.
Concave saddle finger-grip curves along upper and lower longitudinal edges narrowing to ~112.5 mm waist.
Left and right ends feature distinct recessed stepped shelf cutouts flanking the soap bar.
Central front surface features deeply embossed/debossed 'AXE' bold brand typography.
Upper curved shoulder features a series of longitudinal fluted traction ribs/grooves.
Generous rounded cushion perimeter blends (~14 mm radius) wrapping around top and bottom faces.
